pages.title: Life Star
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Crafted at a crafting table with 9 dandelions.$(br2)§lEffect: §r$(br)Active while held or embedded in armor: max health increases from 20 to 50; regeneration speed is doubled; hunger and saturation drain 50% slower (including the saturation consumed by fast regeneration).
Note: fill all 9 crafting slots with dandelions.
